Bodycam Footage Shows Officer at ICE Agent-Involved Shooting in Texas

Bodycam footage captured the arrival of an officer at the scene of a shooting involving an ICE agent in Texas. The incident led to the arrest of a Venezuelan migrant. The coverage includes footage of the officer arriving at the scene and the subsequent arrest.
